threshold_source: TRAIN medians only; computed before any model fit

Retention time is the selected experimental feature; CCS is the author's aligned measured average. Unmodified non-cysteine peptide, charge2.

training.loss: answer-only yes/no plus EOS token CE; no numeric or ranking heads
training.checkpoint_selection: maximum validation mean balanced accuracy of rt and ccs; earliest exact tie

question_contract.rt: measured retention time above TRAIN median
question_contract.both: both conditions hold; composition of two physical endpoints
question_contract.format: unconstrained greedy generation; strip surrounding whitespace, then exactly lowercase yes/no
question_contract.test_template: third held-out wording; two training templates use same semantics

decision.reference: TEXT with nested TRAIN-only specialist predictions plus computed composition/length

scope: new frozen processed-data within-ProteomeTools peptide analytical-property QA benchmark; not original paper split or function/therapeutic generalization
